prompt: Two seasons after Demar Derozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs, who was the leading scorer for the fifth place team in the Western Conference?
answer: Two seasons after DeMar DeRozan was traded to San Antonio (the 2020–21 season), the fifth-place Western Conference team was the Dallas Mavericks. Their leading scorer was **Luka Dončić**, who averaged **27.7 points per game**.
